nodes.summary: For $n \ge 1$ and every $u$ in the simplex, $V_{c}(u) \le \log n$, where $c$ is the uniform point, the minimizer of the entropy. Since $V_c(u) = \sum_i u_i \log(n u_i)$ and $n u_i \le n$, each term is at most $u_i \log n$. The bound is attained at the vertices. Combined with strong convexity it makes the mirror descent rate depend on the dimension only through $\sqrt{\log n}$.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
